name: inaccessible
description: Visually fine but tree-hostile: icon-only buttons without names, aria-label mismatching visible labels, aria-hidden main nav, positive tabindex, role=button divs without tabindex, div-built listbox/date picker/slider (no aria-valuenow), duplicate ids, role=img without a name.

notes.control-accessible-name: Three icon-only <button><svg/></button> in the header on index.html, one on form.html.
notes.label-in-name: form.html: 'Full name' input has aria-label 'Customer'; 'Email address' input has aria-label 'Where to send the receipt'.
notes.aria-validity: role=listbox with plain div children (aria-required-children); role=slider without aria-valuenow (aria-required-attr).
notes.navigation-links-usable: The only nav landmark is aria-hidden=true, so its links are absent from the accessibility snapshot.
notes.keyboard-operability: Positive tabindex 1..3 on the Quick links on index.html; role=button divs have no tabindex.
notes.form-fields-labelled: Phone input on form.html has no label association and no name attribute.
notes.image-alt: <div class=hero role=img> with no accessible name (axe role-img-alt).
notes.duplicate-ids: Two h2 elements share id=duplicate on index.html.
notes.open-order-form: The nav is aria-hidden, but the Quick links section still exposes a real link named Order form, so a tree agent can reach form.html.

tasks.name: find-contact-email
tasks.goal: Find the email address for contacting Northwind Bikes.
